hit.ceilingSoon: usage limit about to be reached (paid credits refused)
wait.savedManual: ⏸ %s limit %s%%: work saved; resume it yourself after %s.
wait.earlyReset: ⚡ %s limit reset ahead of schedule after %s of waiting — continuing where you stopped.
wait.earlyResetNotify: %s limit reset early: the session continues now.
workspace.changed: ⚠ the working tree changed while waiting (the files, the commit or git status differ from the checkpoint).
workspace.context: [noctis] The working tree changed while this session was paused (the files, the commit or git status differ from the checkpoint), so files read or edited before the pause may differ from what is on disk now.
wait.dataReady: %s usage data is back and below the limit%s
wait.wakeMessage: [noctis] %s limit reset at %s (%s%% when paused). Continue exactly where you left off; the task list and pending work are unchanged.
scoped.promptBlock: 🔁 %s %s%%: default model is now %s; type /model %s and resend the request.
scoped.savedManual: 🔁 %s %s%%: work saved, default model is now %s; continue with /model %s.
scoped.savedRelaunch: 🔁 %s %s%%: work saved, resuming with %s in a new window in ~1 min.
scoped.reverted: 🔁 %s weekly quota reset; default model is %s again.
scoped.revertedDefault: 🔁 %s weekly quota reset; settings.json names no model again, so Claude Code's own default applies.
notice.noUsage: %s: no usage data (is statusLine installed? noctis doctor).
notice.routed: 🔀 Research routed to the %s subagent; %s kept for coding.
notice.budget: [noctis] daily budget reached: %s%% of the weekly quota used today (cap %s%%). Finish the current step; prefer lighter work.
handoff.blocked: ⛔ This session has been running in another window with %[2]s since %[1]s; close this window (to force: noctis cancel %[3]s).
selfcheck.statuslineGone: the status line runs %s, which no longer exists (no limit data)
selfcheck.threshold: no threshold on %s: that window is not guarded
selfcheck.thresholdFixed: threshold out of range (1–100): %s — the built-in default is guarding it; fix config.json
selfcheck.token: no OAuth token: the %s weekly rule is off (fine if your plan has no %[1]s bucket)
selfcheck.agentTools: %s: add %s to its disallowedTools (noctis cannot check those calls)
session.checkpoint: %s: the previous session was paused at %s because of a usage limit; resume note %s (full context: %s).
session.alreadyOver: ⏸ %s usage is already %s%%: new work pauses until %s and resumes on its own.
queue.stuckNotify: Queue not progressing: %d open items, session stopped (%s).
queue.stuckMessage: ⛔ Queue not progressing (%d open); auto-continue stopped — see errors.log.
queue.doneNotify: Queue finished: %s has no open items.
queue.doneMessage: ✔ Queue finished — %s has no open items; stopping cleanly.
queue.blockedNotify: Queue blocked: %d open items in %s wait on dependencies that are not done.
queue.blockedMessage: ⛔ Queue blocked: %d open item(s) wait on (after …) dependencies that never completed; stopping.
queue.modeNotice: ☰ Queue mode: %s has %d open item(s) — Claude works through them without asking (/%s:pause to stop; rename the file or set queue.files to opt out).
queue.autoNotice: ☰ %d-step job detected — tracked as a checklist; Claude finishes every step without asking (/%s:pause to stop).
queue.usage:
usage: noctis queue import [--repo owner/name] [--label name] [--file TASKS.md] [--limit 200]
       noctis queue trust | untrust | status [--file TASKS.md]
queue.ghFailed: gh issue list failed: %v (is the GitHub CLI installed and logged in?)
queue.importNone: nothing new: all %d open issues are already in %s
queue.importLink: queue import wrote nothing: %s is a link that leads out of %s (to %s). To import into that file, pass its path with --file.
overload.notify: API %s; retrying with backoff, next attempt at %s.
overload.giveup: API %s persisted for the whole retry budget (%s attempts); the session is stopped — check status.claude.com.
overload.wakeMessage: [noctis] The API was %s (attempt %s, waited %s). Retry now: continue exactly where you left off; nothing else changed.
stopfailure.transient: Transient limit error; work saved, retrying at %s.
stopfailure.wall: Limit wall (%s); work saved, resuming at %s.
stopfailure.giveup: %s kept failing (%s) through %s automatic retries; noctis stopped retrying — open a terminal and run: %s
stopfailure.account: Claude Code stopped with %s; there is nothing to retry until the account is fixed.
stopfailure.modelMissing: Model %s is not available on this plan; the default model is now %s. Pick another profile with /noctis:setup.
notification.stale: Limit reset; Claude Code is waiting for Enter (auto-continue will fire if planned).
notification.disabled: Claude Code dropped its built-in wait; resuming at the planned time.
launch.noClaude: Automatic relaunch of %s failed: the %s command was not found — install it or add it to PATH, then run in %s: %s
launch.noCwd: Automatic relaunch of %s failed: its project folder %s no longer exists — open a terminal in the folder it moved to and run: %s
launch.failed: Automatic relaunch of %s failed — open a terminal in %s and run: %s
runner.noData: Usage data unavailable; auto-resume abandoned for %s (manual: %s).
statusline.moved: · ↪ continues in another window — this one can be closed
fatal.command: %s crashed: %v — the details are in %s; `noctis report --bundle` makes a file to attach to an issue
checkpoint.title: # %s checkpoint
checkpoint.withheld: (%d checkpoint(s) here are already used up or too old to restore)
checkpoint.snapshot: ## Git snapshot of the uncommitted tracked changes (restore with the command)
checkpoint.workflows: ## Dynamic workflows launched in this session
checkpoint.workflowsHint: - If a run did not finish: relaunch it with the same script (completed agents return saved results); never start it over.
status.notSetUp: ! not set up yet — run /%s:setup, then /reload-plugins
status.thresholdsBad: ! no threshold: %s — those windows are NOT guarded
status.thresholdsFixed: ! out of range (1-100): %s — the built-in default is used instead
status.leanFixed: ! wrong type or out of range: %s — the shipped value is used instead
refresh.rejected: the sign-in was refused (HTTP %s); open Claude Code once so it signs in again
refresh.rateLimited: the usage endpoint is rate-limiting; noctis tries again later
refresh.network: could not reach the usage endpoint: %s
refresh.badJSON: the usage endpoint's answer was not JSON
refresh.truncated: the usage endpoint's answer broke off before it was complete
refresh.unexpectedShape: the usage endpoint answered in a shape noctis does not know; the last reading is kept
refresh.codex: Codex did not report its usage: %s
status.skew: Clock skew   : local clock is %d s %s the server (reset times adjusted)
status.observe: Mode         : OBSERVE (decisions are logged, nothing is enforced)
cancel.noneFor: Nothing pending for %s — noctis status lists what is waiting.
cancel.notSaved: Nothing was cancelled: state.json could not be saved — the reason is in %s.
sid.ambiguous: %s matches more than one session (%s); nothing was changed — use more of the id.
off.done: %s disabled until %s — noctis on or /noctis:resume turns it back on now.
off.notSaved: %s is still on: the pause could not be saved — the reason is in %s.
doctor.thresholdsBad: no threshold on %s: those windows are not guarded
doctor.thresholdsFixed: thresholds out of range (1-100): %s — the built-in default is used instead
doctor.fixThresholds: put every threshold back between 1 and 100 in config.json
doctor.leanFixed: compaction settings of the wrong type or out of range: %s — the shipped values are used instead
doctor.fixLean: correct or remove them in config.json; docs/REFERENCE.md says what each one takes
lean.early: on, compacts early at %s of the context
lean.noEarly: on, no early compaction (compaction.compactAtPercent is off)
lean.notice: ▲ context %s full, and lean compaction is not running in this session (Claude Code has not loaded its module): type /compact now to compact with a summary. /noctis:setup turns Claude Code's function hooks on from the next session; --no-lean turns this notice off.
doctor.fixLeanSwitch: lean compaction is on but Claude Code will not load its module: run /noctis:setup (it writes 1 when the switch is missing), or set it to 1 in settings.json → env yourself; or set compaction.lean to false
lean.noticeOld: ▲ context %s full, and lean compaction is not running in this session: Claude Code %s is older than %s, the first version noctis's lean module is tested with. Type /compact now to compact with a summary; after a Claude Code update, /noctis:setup turns the function hooks on from the next session; --no-lean turns this notice off.
doctor.leanOld: Claude Code in the last session: %s, older than %s, the first version the lean module is tested with; an older one may not load it
doctor.fixLeanOld: update Claude Code (claude update) and start a new session; or turn lean compaction off with /noctis:setup --no-lean
doctor.fixCredits: set credits.allowPaid back to false in config.json
doctor.creditsNote: (noctis cannot switch off auto-reload on the account itself — do that in your Anthropic billing settings)
credits.refused: refused — work stops at %s%% and a workflow needs %s points of room
credits.allowed: ALLOWED — past the subscription limit the account pays for the overflow
doctor.usageNone: not yet (created after the first assistant message)
doctor.errorsOld: nothing in the last day (latest entry: %s)
selftest.tooOld: Claude Code %s < %s: rate_limits missing from the status line, limit protection will not work
selftest.newer: Claude Code %s: above the tested range (%s–%s); if hook field names changed you will see the ⚠ hooks inactive warning
selftest.inRange: Claude Code %s within the tested range
selftest.pulseNone: hook pulse: none yet — run one Claude turn and try again
selftest.notifyBody: Self-test notification: if you see this, beep/toast works.
selftest.notifyNone: no desktop notification here (%s): alarms stay silent on this machine; waits are unaffected
selftest.taskWaiting: Task Scheduler test: task registered for 1 min from now, waiting for it to fire (up to 120 s)...
selftest.taskFired: Task Scheduler task fired and the runner binary ran
selftest.taskMissed: Task Scheduler task did not fire within 2 min — check errors.log and the Task Scheduler history
selftest.wakeFail: powercfg /waketimers failed (may need admin); Power options > Sleep > Allow wake timers
report.byModel: By model (input / output / cache read / cache write · calls):
report.keptOff: Kept off %s: %s tokens in %d subagent calls on other models; other subagent tokens: %s
report.events: Events: %d routed · %d waits · %d scoped switches · %d queue continues · %d auto-launches
report.cost: API-equivalent cost: %s (list prices; informational on a subscription)
report.unpriced: no price known for: %s (add report.pricing in config.json)
report.saved: Kept off the primary model saved ≈ %s (those calls cost %s instead of %s)
report.bundle: bug-report bundle written: %s (logs, journal, state, config; home path, tokens and webhooks redacted — attach it to an issue)
install.permissions: permissions.defaultMode=%s (before setup: %s; noctis setup --permissions %s puts it back)
install.permissionsUnset: permissions.defaultMode=%s (not set before setup; delete it from settings.json to go back)
install.permissionsOther: permissions.defaultMode=%s (before setup: %s, which setup cannot set; set it again in settings.json to go back)
install.permissionsKept: permissions.defaultMode left at %s (setup changes it only on the account's first setup or with --permissions)
install.permissionsNone: permissions.defaultMode left unset (setup changes it only on the account's first setup or with --permissions)
install.lean: env.CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1: lean compaction can run (Claude Code's early-access function hooks; this loads the hooks module of every installed plugin; --no-lean to leave it off)
install.leanKept: lean compaction cannot run: settings.json sets CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS to %s, and setup leaves your value (1 lets it run)
install.leanOff: lean compaction off: compaction.lean is false, and CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS is left as it is
install.leanOffRemoved: lean compaction off: compaction.lean is false, and the CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS setup had written is removed
host.question: Which AI coding tool is this install for? (type the number)
update.downloaded: ⬆ %s %s was downloaded (this session still runs %s): run /reload-plugins, or restart the tool, to switch.
update.downloadedNotify: Version %s is ready — reload plugins or restart to switch.
update.autoEnabled: ✔ marketplace auto-update on for %s: new versions arrive on their own (Claude Code checks after each session start)
update.autoFailed: could not enable marketplace auto-update for %s — run: claude plugin marketplace update %[1]s --auto-update
update.autoHint: To get new versions on their own: claude plugin marketplace update %s --auto-update
update.hostCommand: download the new release and run setup again
host.badChoice: unknown choice %q — type a number from the list
host.hooksBroken: hook file %s is not valid JSON (%s); fix or remove it, then run setup again
host.choices: nothing was changed; --host and NOCTIS_HOST take one of:
install.incomplete: %d file(s) could not be written; nothing to reload yet — see %s and run setup again
host.exeMissing: !! %s is not on PATH; install %s first, the hooks start working as soon as it runs
host.noLimits: note: %s does not expose usage percentages to scripts, so the limit guard stays off here; queue mode, checkpoints and error backoff work
host.next.codex: Next: open Codex, run /hooks and trust the noctis hooks once (Codex skips untrusted hooks). Limits are read through `codex app-server`; sessions resume with `codex exec resume`.
host.next.antigravity: Next: restart agy; /hooks lists the plugin's hooks and /statusline shows its line (quota + reset). Sessions resume with `agy --conversation <id> -p`.
host.next.droid: Next: restart droid; /hooks lists the plugin's hooks. Sessions resume with `droid exec --session-id <id>`.
host.next.copilot: Next: restart copilot; hooks load from ~/.copilot/hooks. Sessions resume with `copilot --resume=<id> -p`.
doctor.coexistHooks: %d other %s hook(s) in settings.json also run; all hooks of an event run and every 'continue' is honoured, so a loop plugin and the queue can both push the same turn — harmless, but pause one of them if you see double continues
doctor.coexistPlugins: plugins that touch the same surfaces (loops, auto-resume, status lines, usage): %s — the status line is chained, hooks are additive; if two tools both auto-resume, keep one
doctor.hostHooksGone: hooks wired: %s — but they run %s, which no longer exists
doctor.usageOff: usage data: %s has no script-readable limits (limit guard off)
install.restored: settings.json: statusLine, effort and permission mode set back to what they were before setup (a value you changed since stays); %s.
install.modelKept: model setting kept (setup had not changed it)
install.modelRemoved: model setting removed (there was none before setup)
install.configBroken: %s cannot be read (%s); nothing was changed — fix the file or move it aside, then run setup again
install.configUnwritable: %s could not be written (%s); settings were left as they were — make its folder writable, then run setup again
install.uninstallBroken: %s cannot be read (%s); nothing was removed — fix it, then run the uninstall again
install.undoByHand: or put it back by hand: remove statusLine, permissions.defaultMode, model, env.CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL and env.CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS where setup set them, or restore the oldest settings.json.bak-* copy
install.nested: source (%s) and target (%s) are nested; unpack the plugin somewhere else and retry
install.checksumFailed: the shipped binary does not match bin/SHA256SUMS (%s); not installed — re-download the plugin
install.settingsBroken: settings.json unreadable (%s); fix the JSON error first
install.defaultsMissing: config.default.json not found under %s — run setup from the plugin folder, or point CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT at it
setup.done: setup complete: binary at %s, statusLine wired, model=%s
roles.intro: Which model should do which kind of work? Enter a profile name (noctis, balanced, economy) or 'custom' to choose per role. Values are model or model:effort (effort: low, medium, high, xhigh, max).
roles.fallback: fallback when the scoped quota is out
roles.badModel: %s: %s is not a model name (only letters, digits and . _ : @ / [ ] -)
roles.unknownModel: %s: %s is not a model Claude Code knows — use opus, sonnet, haiku, fable, best or opusplan, or a full id such as claude-opus-5-5
roles.badEffort: %s: unknown effort '%s' (low, medium, high, xhigh, max)
roles.effortIgnored: %s takes a model only; the effort %s is ignored (the Agent tool has no effort)
roles.modelNoEffort: %s: %s takes no effort level; the effort %s is ignored
roles.retuned: the %s profile was re-tuned in %s (%s); this configuration still holds the earlier one — /noctis:setup --profile %s adopts it
home.missing: %s: the home folder is not known (HOME is not set), so the account folder cannot be found; set HOME or pass --account <folder>.
help.cmd.classify: print the router's verdict for a prompt as JSON
help.cmd.schedulepreview: print what a relaunch would register with the scheduler, without registering it
help.usage:
%s %s — keeps an AI coding session inside its usage limits.

Usage: noctis <command> [--flags]
help.more: Flags per command: https://github.com/synex1437/noctis/blob/main/docs/REFERENCE.md. Diagnose a setup with: noctis doctor
help.cmd.status: what the plugin sees right now: usage, windows, waits
help.cmd.doctor: check the wiring and say what to fix
help.cmd.why: the last decisions and the reason for each
help.cmd.report: usage report; --bundle writes a redacted diagnostic zip
help.cmd.setup: set up the tool, roles, thresholds and settings.json (status line, model, effort, permission mode)
help.cmd.install: place the binary and wire the host; --uninstall reverts it
help.cmd.ensure: re-place the binary and repair the status line
help.cmd.cancel: end every pending wait and its relaunch, or one session's with noctis cancel <id>
help.cmd.off: pause the guard for 60 minutes or as long as given (90m, 2h); noctis on ends it early
help.cmd.model: print the default model; with --sid <id>, that session's
help.cmd.queue: queue import: GitHub issues into TASKS.md; queue trust | untrust | status: a queue file
help.cmd.checkpoint: print this folder's latest unused checkpoint, or NONE
help.cmd.check: exit code from the usage already recorded: 0 below every threshold, 10 warn band, 11 threshold reached, 20 no fresh data
help.cmd.selftest: prove the plugin is wired and working
help.cmd.webhook: send a test message to alarm.webhook.url and say whether it arrived
webhook.refused: alarm.webhook.url is not usable: it must be https (http only for localhost)
webhook.circuitOpen: the last deliveries failed, so webhooks pause until %s (noctis webhook without --title and --body sends a test now)
webhook.testBody: Test message: if you see this, noctis can reach you here.
hook.miswired: %s: the host called the plugin without its command argument — the guard ran anyway, but check the hook wiring with: noctis doctor
wait.notStored: %s: could not save the pause (is another window writing, or the disk full?) — nothing was paused; check noctis doctor
doctor.fixStatusline: run /noctis:setup (or noctis setup) to wire the status line
doctor.fixSetup: run /noctis:setup (or noctis setup) to write the missing settings
doctor.fixConfig: correct config.json by hand (the error is in brackets above); until then noctis uses its defaults
doctor.fixToken: sign in to Claude Code once, or set CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
doctor.fixTokenExpired: open Claude Code once so it renews the sign-in (or run /login), or set CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
doctor.fixUsage: open a Claude Code session so the status line reports usage once
doctor.fixUsageHost: start a session in %s so noctis can read its limits
doctor.fixRoles: correct that role in the roles section of config.json, or run /noctis:setup to choose the roles again
doctor.fixErrors: the entries are in %s; delete the file once they are handled (entries older than a day stop counting)
status.launchFailed: !!  automatic relaunch of %s failed at %s — resume it with: %s
doctor.schedulerSleeper: (normal: no launchd/systemd/schtasks here, so a lightweight sleeper process is used instead)
queue.trustAsk: ☰ %s in this folder holds %d open item(s). It is not driving this session: a checklist can arrive with a repository, and driving means working through it without stopping to ask. To let it drive: noctis queue trust (%s)
queue.trustRevoked: This file no longer drives sessions: %s
queue.fileMissing: No queue file at %s — nothing changed. Check the name, or name the project folder with --cwd.
doctor.fixDisabled: noctis on (or /noctis:resume) turns the guard back on now
doctor.fixClaude: install Claude Code or put claude on PATH; relaunching a paused session needs it
doctor.fixSettings: fix the JSON error in %s, then run noctis doctor again
doctor.fixSettingsOpen: make %s a readable file — not a folder, with read permission, not locked by another program — then run noctis doctor again
doctor.fixEffort: run /noctis:setup (or noctis setup) to write %s, or put the level you want in models.effort in config.json
doctor.fixPluginRoot: reinstall the plugin, or run noctis setup from the copy you use
doctor.fixAgent: reinstall the plugin, or set router.agent in config.json to an agent whose file exists
doctor.fixHost: install %s or put %s on PATH; relaunching a paused session needs it
doctor.allGood: Everything the plugin needs is in place.
